item.title: Senate Majority leader warns Dems are putting cyber operations at risk as Iran threat looms
item.summary: Senate Majority Leader John Thune accused Democrats of holding government agencies hostage during a partial shutdown, citing concerns over TSA and cyber operations amid Iranian threats.

item.title: Deadly blasts at market and hospital raise fears of renewed Boko Haram insurgency in Nigeria
item.summary: Nigeria suicide bombings in Maiduguri killed at least 23 people and wounded over 100 others in deadly attacks targeting a hospital and market Monday night.

item.title: White House, after top counterterrorism official quits, says Trump had 'strong' evidence Iran would attack US
item.summary: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt said Tuesday that top counterterrorism official Joe Kent's resignation letter had "many false claims."

item.title: Iran wrestling champion speaks out against country's treatment of female athletes amid soccer player concerns
item.summary: Iranian women soccer players returned home after Australia's asylum offer, allegedly facing threats to their families for not standing during the national anthem.

item.title: Comedy club owner with terminal cancer guns down ex-in-law, hunts ex-wife before turning up dead
item.summary: Comedy club owner Mathew Thomas Becker reportedly shot and killed his ex-father-in-law Romaine Clark and attempted to murder his ex-wife in Anchorage before being found dead.

item.title: Trump calls mail in voting corrupt as Senate begins debate on SAVE Act requiring voter ID
item.summary: Trump calls mail-in voting 'corrupt as hell' as Senate advances SAVE America Act requiring voter ID and citizenship proof for federal elections nationwide.

item.title: Luke Combs says ‘who the f--- cares’ if choosing family time over industry parties costs him awards
item.summary: 'Fast Car' singer Luke Combs prioritizes family over fame, saying he'd skip industry events and miss out on awards to spend time with his three kids.

item.title: Dems unmoved as White House reveals DHS concessions in shutdown battle
item.summary: The White House revealed five immigration enforcement compromises to Dems as the government shutdown continues, including body cameras for DHS agents and beefed-up oversight.

item.title: Christina Haack wows in cream-colored crochet bikini after addressing rumors she's engaged for fourth time
item.summary: Christina Haack stunned in a cream crochet bikini during a tropical getaway, promoting her champagne brand while addressing recent engagement speculation.

item.title: Jerry Jones highlights additions, sees Cowboys rebound after team failed to play 'a lick of defense last year'
item.summary: Dallas Cowboys owner Jerry Jones expressed optimism about the team's defense after adding six new players this offseason. Dallas finished 30th in total defense last season.
